description: NoVA Street Network Connectivity Atlas is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Keystone GIS (Keystone GIS Northern Virginia GIS Research Program). Intersection density, cul-de-sac burden and link-node ratio across all 579 Northern Virginia census tracts, rebuilt from 2024 TIGER/Line road centerlines.Produced by the Keystone GIS Northern Virginia Autonomous GIS Research Program. Full methodology, interactive map, and FGDC metadata: https://keystonegis.com/datasets/nova-street-connectivity-day75.html. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
